name: import_item
title: Import item
description: Import new entries into the personal library, either from local PDF files or from identifiers (DOI / ISBN / arXiv ID). Always runs as a two-step confirm: the first call (confirmed=false, default) returns a metadata preview plus suggested collections; re-call with confirmed=true to actually write. paths and identifiers are mutually exclusive.

paths.description: Absolute paths of local PDF files to import.

identifiers.description: DOI, ISBN, or arXiv IDs, e.g. "10.1234/foo", "arXiv:2401.12345".

containerId.description: Collection to add the imported items to.

autoClassify.description: When true, the preview includes suggestedCollections based on keyword overlap with existing collections.

confirmed.description: Must be true to perform the write. false returns a preview only.
